## Independence and limits
does not reuse NeuralPDE loss lowering. Calculus additionally uses hand formulas,
ForwardDiff and FD. M6 compares a solver against analytic functions. Inference
FD/AD share a solver, with analytic decay and oscillator cross-checks. HNN/UDE
fixtures use native Lux parameters, not fitted weights. Cartesian/radial LJ and
nonstationary UDE comparisons share Tsit5 and are reduction checks, not independent
integrator validation. Eigen tests check direct residuals rather than stored
residual metadata. Bare arrays cannot reveal falsely declared sensor/coordinate
identities; explicit mismatched sensor metadata and changed training grids fail.
No optional ML environment is added to base dependencies. No optimizer is invoked
by M10A's gates. M10B numerical-type torture, M10C scale/memory stress, and M10D
cross-milestone API unification remain deferred. No push or tag is authorized.

excerpt.text: # M10A early mathematics inventory (M1–M7)
All checks are bounded audit fixtures, not completeness or continuum certificates.
`T` below means `test/`. Numeric closures are independent of AML-generated callables.
| Subsystem / object | Mathematical obligation | Independent oracle | Tolerance / exactness | Status / regression | Finding / limitation |

| M1–M2 scalar report | Values, first/second derivatives; FD convergence | Hand polynomial/trigonometric/exponential derivatives, ForwardDiff on a separate closure; analytic forward/central error for x³ | Values 2e-12; AD 2e-11; first FD 2e-7; convergence errors 2e-12 | Verified: `T/m10a_calculus_dynamics.jl`, scalar calculus | Smooth seeded bounded samples only; FD is approximate |

| M3 original domain | Cancelled denominators and logarithm exclusions remain excluded | Original mathematical denominators/sign restrictions | Exact membership/exception assertions | Verified: same file, original-domain exclusions | Legacy univariate `evaluate` does not enforce the stored real domain; explicitly not claimed otherwise |

| M4 scalar field | Ordered gradient, directional derivative, symmetric Hessian | Explicit vector/matrix formula, independent AD closure, value-only central FD | AD/analytic 2e-11; gradient FD 2e-7; Hessian FD 2e-6 with h=2e-4 | Verified: same file, ordered gradient/Hessian | Variables deliberately `(y,x)`; wrong sign/order negative controls |

| M5 vector field | Rectangular Jacobian and column order | Explicit 3×2 matrix, independent AD and directional FD | 2e-11 analytic/AD; 2e-7 FD | Verified: same testset | No giant Hessian or scaling work |

| M6 trajectories | Constant exponential decay, exp(-t²), harmonic oscillator, logistic reference satisfy ODE and IC before use | Independent reference closures and hand RHS; AD in time; off-step solution evaluation | Reference 2e-11; solver 1e-11; sampled trajectory comparison 2e-8 | Verified: same file, reference equation/IC audits | Solver comparison is against analytic functions, not another invocation of the same solver; no global error bound |

| M6 order/bindings | q/v state order; full `(m,k)` and inferred `(k,m)` parameter order; observed `(v,q)` | Explicit harmonic solution; unequal named m=2,k=8 mechanics binding | ODE comparison 2e-8; algebraic 1e-12 | Verified: `T/m10a_mechanics.jl` EL oscillator and `T/m10a_inference_operators.jl` oscillator | M6 Float64 boundary unchanged; inference dual-number path audited separately |

| M7 force | F=-∇V with reordered coordinates | Hand differentiated quartic/cross potential plus independent AD | 1e-12 | Verified: `T/m10a_mechanics.jl`, force | Deliberate positive-gradient force is rejected by audit predicate |

| M7 Hamiltonian | Canonical J, q/p blocks, signs and cross term | Explicit 4×4 J and component equations | Exact J/order; 1e-12 field | Verified: same file, canonical signs | Wrong sign and interleaved ordering fail; no noncanonical mechanics claim |

| M7 regular Legendre map | EL oscillator; L/H vector fields agree under p=Mv | Explicit non-diagonal SPD M, K; `(v,-M⁻¹Kq)` and `(M⁻¹p,-Kq)`; quadratic energy | 1e-12 | Verified: same file, regular Legendre | Affine regular momentum map only, no constrained-system extension |

| M7 local mechanics | Nonzero equilibrium and reordered M/C/K; damping restriction | Independently specified full matrices and direct acceleration | Exact coefficient comparisons, 1e-12 field | Verified: same file, equilibrium M/C/K | Incorrect equilibrium and damped undamped-mode request remain unknown |

| M7 small-amplitude limit | Nonlinear pendulum approaches linear oscillator | Taylor bound `|sin(a)-a|≤a³/6`; explicit sin/cos linear solution | Algebraic cubic bound; solver 1e-12, trajectory difference <a³/3 at t=1 | Verified: same file, local nonlinear limit | Bounded amplitudes/times; not long-term validity |

| M7 modes | K a=λ M a, M-orthogonality, zero/negative/degenerate semantics | Direct matrix residual; roots of det(K-λM); degenerate-subspace projector | Residual ≤1e-11 times matrix/vector scale; orthogonality 1e-12 | Verified: same file, generalized eigenpairs | Shifted eigenvalue rejected; eigenvectors in repeated subspaces are not unique; numerical zeros are not exact certificates |

excerpt.text: # M10A M8 inventory
The recovered `test/m10a_atomistic_statistics.jl` was coherent and is retained
unchanged. It passes 290 assertions without Molly or another optional stack.
All rows below refer to named testsets in that file.
| Subsystem / object | Mathematical obligation | Independent oracle | Tolerance / exactness | Status / regression | Finding / limitation |

| Geometry / pair distances | Symmetry, self zero, unordered pair population, 2D/3D order | 3–4–5 coordinates, direct Euclidean norm; explicit pair list | Exact pair/index/zero assertions, default Float64 `≈` for distances | Verified: Geometry | Private distance primitive used only for self-distance, absent from public unordered pair enumeration |

| Geometry / periodic distances and RDF | Multi-box minimum image; dimensional shells | 29→-1 in length 10; annulus volumes and 3D spherical shells | Float64 `≈`; exact populations | Verified: Geometry | Supported orthorhombic boundaries only; unsupported dimensions/boundaries return unknown |

| LJ potential | 4ε[(σ/r)^12-(σ/r)^6]; F=-dV/dr; rmin=2^(1/6)σ, Vmin=-ε, curvature | Explicit scalar formula and independent AD of it | V/F 1e-11 relative +1e-12 absolute; equilibrium force 1e-10; curvature AD 1e-10 relative | Verified: LJ formula/sign | Repulsive/attractive regions tested; no cutoff or many-body claim |

| Atomistic modes | Particle-major Cartesian masses, equilibrium order, residual, translations | Explicit spring-block K and diag(2,2,3,3); λ=(0,0,2.5,2.5); direct residual and translation projector | Residual <1e-11; orthogonality/projector 1e-12 | Verified: Cartesian mode bridge | Caller Hessian equilibrium remains not verified; translation claim justified only by this constructed spring fixture |

| Moments / running statistics | Mean, sample variance, prefix values | [1,2,3,4], mean 5/2 and variance 5/3 | Exact rational-derived values or Float64 `≈` | Verified: Hand moments | Missing/constant data do not manufacture uncertainty |

| Correlation / IAT / ESS | Biased N vs unbiased N-lag covariance; window and clamping; ESS | Hand autocovariances, τ=3/4 samples, ESS=8/3, SEM=sqrt(5/8) | Exact discrete metadata; Float64 `≈`, cancellation 1e-14 | Verified: Hand moments | Finite descriptive estimates, not stationarity/mixing certificates |

| Blocking | Block means, discarded tails, counts, variance/SEM | [1,2,3,4,99] with block sizes 2 and 3 | Exact arrays | Verified: Hand moments | Discard is explicit; too few blocks give unavailable uncertainty |

| Time metadata | stride is not dt; missing timestamps stay missing; index time not physical time | Explicit interval 0.5 vs dt=0.1 and stride=5; unknown and irregular clocks | Exact metadata/exception assertions | Verified: Time honesty | IAT/VACF require regular physical or explicitly declared index time; no fabricated timestamps |

| MSD / VACF | Displacement and pair/origin averages | Hand two-particle frames: MSD=(0,2.5,10), VACF=(35/3,10,15/2) | Float64 `≈`; exact counts/time | Verified: Time honesty | Single-origin MSD; irregular-time MSD is allowed at explicit elapsed times, stationary-lag VACF is refused |

| Mechanical observations | K=Σmv²/2, E=K+V, momentum, COM, temperature | Unequal masses and Unitful fixture: K=7J,V=-3J,E=4J, P=(0,4), COM=(4/3,0); T=2K/(dof kB) | Exact where representable, otherwise unit-aware `≈` | Verified: Mechanical observations | Temperature requires both caller DOF and Boltzmann constant; neither is inferred |

| NVE / diagnostics | Conservation expectation only for total energy; false is not proof of nonconservation | All nine energy-kind/ensemble combinations plus constant kinetic series | Exact boolean semantics; explicit deviation/slope arithmetic | Verified: Mechanical observations | Existing fix `1bb7897` protected, not rediscovered as a new source bug |

| Comparison | Stored difference B-A; independent uncertainty only with assumptions | Shifted hand series and sqrt(SEM_A²+SEM_B²) | Exact sign; Float64 `≈` uncertainty | Verified: Stored B-A | Self-comparison and incompatible uncertainty windows do not imply independent uncertainty |

| Comparison refusal | Incompatible units, grids, shapes, clocks, coordinate conventions, estimators | Deliberately incompatible pairs; assert no difference value | Exact compatibility checks and `nothing` | Verified: Stored B-A | No automatic truncation, interpolation, alignment or resampling |
Default Float64 `≈` is used only for small well-scaled hand fixtures, not as a
universal scientific error bound. Numeric-type stress and large trajectories are
M10B/C, not this audit. See `m10a_audit.md` for the overall ledger.
